I commit to 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic today, provided John also commits and Luke holds to zero. Our neighbors need treatment, and this plan gives us a clear way to help without abandoning the lake’s recovery.

I’ll share my catch record and donation receipt, then limit my catch to 6 tons next month if we start at 80. After that, I support the 10-ton share for each of us. John, you’re the remaining person we need—will you join?
